name: Custom Cash

benefits.name: 5% Cash Back on Top Eligible Spend Category
benefits.description: 5 ThankYou Points per dollar (5% cash back equivalent) on the cardholder's highest-spend eligible category each billing cycle, on up to $500 in that category; 1% thereafter. No enrollment or selection — Citi determines the top category automatically.
benefits.terms: Applies automatically to whichever eligible category the cardholder spent the most in during that billing cycle — there is nothing to select or activate, and the category can differ every cycle. Capped at $500 of spend per billing cycle (max 2,500 bonus points, i.e. $25), after which that category earns 1%. Citi's eligible categories are restaurants, gas stations, grocery stores, select travel, select transit, select streaming services, drugstores, home improvement stores, fitness clubs and live entertainment; the "select" qualifiers mean merchant-code eligibility within those categories is narrower than the slug suggests. Rewards accrue as ThankYou Points, redeemable for cash back at 1 cent per point.

earningRates.terms: 1 ThankYou Point per dollar on all purchases outside the top eligible category, and on top-category spend above the $500 monthly cap.

_note: Closed to new applicants 2026-05-28 (Citi's product page states this; there was no press release). Existing cardholders keep the card and its earning structure, which is why benefits[] is populated rather than emptied. The 5% category list is corroborated by Citi's own 2021 launch press release and the current product page; re-verify against cardholder terms if Citi changes terms for the closed-to-new-applicants population.
